worldcombat.skill.partingshot.summary: Hurl a barbed parting word at your aim, first contact wins: when it sticks in a foe, its Attack and Sp. Atk drop several stages and it wears the humiliation mark; then a legal reserve switches in, or you back off step by step. A word that gets blocked neither drops stages nor moves you.
worldcombat.skill.partingshot.use.0: Cut the foe's output, then disengage
worldcombat.skill.partingshot.use.1: Disarm a pursuer on your way out
worldcombat.skill.partingshot.use.2: Fire a barb, then open the distance
worldcombat.skill.partingshot.descriptio: On a hit, the foe loses %1$s Attack and Sp. Atk stages and carries the humiliation mark for %2$s. The stat drop lasts until the fight ends or a stage reset removes it; while marked, companions will not hurl the barb at it again, and effects that clear harmful statuses can dispel the mark.
Word range %1$s blocks and flight speed %2$s blocks/tick; on a hit you step up to %3$s blocks away from the foe, while a whiffed word neither drops stages nor moves you.
After a hit: with a legal reserve waiting, it switches in at the same spot; without one, you back off up to %1$s blocks step by step and stop at a wall.
worldcombat.skill.partingshot.venom.on: Venom: always drops 2 stages, humiliation ×1.3 — at the cost of range ×0.85, flight ×0.8 (slower, easier to dodge), cooldown +14.
worldcombat.skill.partingshot.venom.off: Quick tongue: range ×1.1, flight ×1.1, cooldown −6; the bite follows Sp. Atk alone.
worldcombat.skill.partingshot.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.partingshot.growth.0: From level %1$s the humiliation rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.partingshot.growth.1: From level %1$s the word reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.partingshot.preference: On: always drops 2 stages, humiliation ×1.3, range ×0.85, flight ×0.8, cooldown +14. Off (quick tongue): range ×1.1, flight ×1.1, cooldown −6, bite follows Sp. Atk alone.
Only hurls the barb when the foe is this close; lower it for point-blank only, raise it to speak up earlier.
When on, the user leaves its post under a hold order to hurl the barb.
